profile.headline: Software Engineer at Rippling

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Dec 2025 - now: Working on AI x Flex Benefits
Nov 2024 - Dec 2025: Building Flexible Benefits products across the stack (FSA, HSA, Commuter benefits)

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Architected and implemented a scalable, multi-milestone fullstack tool for managing credit bureau data transformations that reduced mapping errors by 41%
- Built a RESTful API using Node.js for storing and retrieving mappings via GitHub API
- Built UI in React for defining mappings with validations
- Developed automated .xlsx generator for external customer data sharing

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Led backend integration of Philippines credit bureau API:
- Implemented a scalable solution using PostgreSQL for state management and Bull (Redis) for asynchronous processing
- Extended our user authentication solution to include selfie biometric authentication
- Included retry logic, comprehensive error handling, and holistic monitoring, enabling quick resolution of any upstream bureau API issues and 99.9% uptime of the integration

Developed comprehensive unit testing framework for ETL processes:
- Replaced 10-month manual QA process with automated tests
- Created a test generator, generating tests automatically for 72% of mapping transformations

Engineered cross-service data transfer solution for Indian credit reports:
- Implemented secure, compliant data flow handling 54% of all bureau report request volume

Mentored new engineers on integration best practices

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Spearheaded integration of Spain credit bureau API:
- Designed and implemented scalable backend solution similar to Philippines integration
- Maintained 23 API integrations

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Created an auto-resolving system of work orders for smart lock maintenance across all properties (Django, Vuex, Postgresql)

positions.title: Backend Platform Intern
positions.description:
Implemented a highly scalable solution to prevent a race condition from hiding users’ matches. Used PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, and Redis to cut down the occurrence by 95% (Java, SQL, Scala)

Summer Intern Hackathon Second Place Winner

positions.title: Summer Software Engineering and Robotics Intern
positions.description: Created a backend plugin for metric tracking and visualization of USV boat performance using publisher/subscriber model (Python, JavaScript)

positions.title: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellow
positions.description:
- Worked on state-of-the-art image making software for cosmological simulations
- Added path-making ability to 3D visualization engine for galaxy simulations

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
- Participated in the creation of a “toaster charger,” to charge “r- one” robots faster than computer
- Tested the optimal broadcast time for the robots; Learned basics for robot programming (Python)

allTitles: Summer Software Engineering and Robotics Intern
